title: Robust Visual Question Answering: Datasets, Methods, and Future Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) datasets (e.g., VQA-CP) where answer distributions for question types differ from training data, and measuring consistency across rephrased questions (e.g., VQA-Rephrasings).

Evaluating accuracy on datasets (e.g., VQACE) that identify and test against specific statistical shortcuts involving the co-occurrence of textual words and visual elements (e.g., 'doing' + 'man' + 'surfboard' → 'surfing').

Assessing model reliance on visual priors or shortcuts (e.g., assuming a specific answer based on the presence of an object regardless of the question) using specific datasets (e.g., VQA-VS) or metrics focused on visual grounding.
